# routeur_workspace (Resource)

A workspace: the default scope for routing rules and policies. Creating one also creates its default project and its Default route; deleting it removes them too. A workspace created through the API (and so by Terraform) gets a default project with the slug `<workspace slug>-core`; the workspace an organisation starts with has one called `core`. Refer to the default project by `default_project_id` (or the `routeur_project` data source with that id) rather than by guessing its slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "routeur_workspace" "payments" {
  slug        = "payments"
  name        = "Payments"
  description = "Checkout, refunds and fraud screening."
}

# Every workspace comes with a default project; API keys created without a
# project land there.
output "payments_default_project" {
  value = routeur_workspace.payments.default_project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, 1–80 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `slug` (String) Unique in the organisation: the workspace's URL identity. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 55 characters (the default project is created as `<slug>-core`). Set at create only; changing it replaces the workspace.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description, at most 255 characters. Stored verbatim; `""` stays `""`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `default_project_id` (String) Id of the workspace's default project (`proj_…`): where a new API key lands when it names no project. Null only for a workspace that has none.
- `id` (String) Public id of the workspace (`ws_…`). Pass it as `workspace_id` to resources that live in the workspace.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organisation's default workspace, which cannot be deleted.
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# id: the workspace id (ws_…) or its slug
import {
  to = routeur_workspace.payments
  id = "ws_3"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By id
terraform import routeur_workspace.payments ws_3

# or by slug
terraform import routeur_workspace.payments payments
```
